prompt: I need to batch-fetch user profiles from Valkey in my Django view. Write Python code that gets 100 user keys (user:1 through user:100) efficiently using the synchronous GLIDE client. Handle timeouts and return a dict mapping user IDs to their data.

assertions.name: Uses glide_sync not glide
assertions.description: Should import from glide_sync for synchronous client

assertions.name: Uses mget for batch fetch
assertions.description: Should use mget() to fetch multiple keys efficiently, not individual get() calls

assertions.name: Catches TimeoutError specifically
assertions.description: Should catch TimeoutError (or TimeoutException) specifically, not generic Exception

assertions.name: Uses context manager or explicit close
assertions.description: Should use context manager or call client.close() explicitly

assertions.name: Returns dict mapping IDs to data
assertions.description: Should return dict like {1: data, 2: data, ...} mapping user IDs to their profile data
